modmenu.descriptionTranslation.nbmusic: Load a MIDI file and get a schematic of note blocks that plays it: compact snake layout, settings window, preview playback and an in-world hologram.
nbmusic.cmd.list_empty: The folder is empty. Put .mid / .nbs / .mp3 / .wav / .ogg into %s
nbmusic.cmd.transcribing: Transcribing “%s” — this takes up to a minute, the result will appear in chat
nbmusic.error.build_too_big: The build is too large (%s blocks) — use export and WorldEdit or Litematica
nbmusic.error.build_too_high: A build %s blocks tall does not fit within the world height
nbmusic.error.format: Format .%s is not supported: use MIDI, NBS, MP3, WAV or OGG
nbmusic.error.mp3_no_frames: MP3 not recognized: no MPEG Layer III frames found
nbmusic.error.no_notes_heard: Could not hear a single note
nbmusic.error.ogg_client_only: OGG can only be decoded in the game client — use the mod window or MP3/WAV
nbmusic.error.schem_too_big: The schematic is larger than 65535 blocks along one axis: %s×%s×%s
nbmusic.error.too_long: The track is too long (max %s min)
nbmusic.error.wav_encoding: Encoding %s is not supported, save the WAV as PCM
nbmusic.export.litematica: Litematica: the schematic is in the Load Schematics menu
nbmusic.export.too_big_for_block: (larger than 48³ — structure blocks cannot load it)
nbmusic.gui.hint: Put .mid / .nbs / .mp3 / .wav / .ogg into the folder or pick one with “Browse…”
nbmusic.gui.no_server_mod: NoteBlock Music is not installed on the server — use export instead
nbmusic.gui.too_large: The file is larger than 2 MB
nbmusic.net.no_permission: Building requires operator rights (cheats in singleplayer)
nbmusic.net.too_far: The hologram is more than %s blocks away from you
nbmusic.net.upload_bad: The file is damaged or larger than 2 MB
nbmusic.net.upload_missing: The file did not reach the server, try again
nbmusic.summary: “%s”: %s s, notes %s → %s (dropped %s, octave-shifted %s), levels %s, rows %s, size %s×%s×%s
